How it works

From registration to first order.

Keep these ready

  • GST registration
  • PAN of the business
  • Company or firm registration
  • Product catalogue or rate card
  • Two or three recent client references
  1. 1

    Register

    Submit the form below with your company details, categories and the cities you serve.

  2. 2

    Review

    Our procurement team checks your details and documents, and may ask for references.

  3. 3

    Qualify

    For larger packages we may visit a past site or your facility, or ask for samples.

  4. 4

    Empanel

    Approved vendors join our list and receive enquiries for matching packages.
